title: Cartologist: Rename Compass→Cartologist across hub, build Flask web interface at port 8080
perceive: DEPENDENCY: Spinner lug must complete first (it updates compass_report.py's LATHE constant to spinner path). Then read: (1) hub/tools/compass_report.py — understand all path constants (COMPASS_STATE, DECISIONS_FILE, REPORTS_DIR) and the generate_html() function signature: what parameters does it take and does it return a string? (2) hub/tools/compass_decide.py — understand the DECISIONS_FILE path and the approve/defer/reject command pattern. (3) hub/WAI-Hub/advisors/gardener/scripts/wheel-tender.sh — find ALL occurrences of 'compass' (tool calls, path flags, comments). (4) hub/WAI-Hub/advisors/gardener/scripts/run_nightly.py — find compass_report.py call in post-tend chain. (5) hub/tools/triumvirate_route.py — find --decisions argument default path. (6) hub/WAI-Hub/advisors/compass/WEB-INTERFACE.md — read the full Flask route spec (5 routes already designed). Map every compass occurrence before writing a single edit.
execute: PART A — RENAME: Step 1: Copy hub/WAI-Hub/advisors/compass/ to hub/WAI-Hub/advisors/cartologist/ using \cp -r hub/WAI-Hub/advisors/compass hub/WAI-Hub/advisors/cartologist. Move hub/WAI-Hub/advisors/compass/ to ~/projects/trash_bin/hub/WAI-Hub/advisors/compass/ (mkdir -p first). Step 2: Read hub/tools/compass_report.py fully. Write hub/tools/cartologist_report.py with: COMPASS_STATE path updated from 'advisors/compass' to 'advisors/cartologist', DECISIONS_FILE path updated, REPORTS_DIR path updated, HTML title and footer strings changed from 'Compass' to 'Cartologist' in generate_html(), any print statements updated. Move hub/tools/compass_report.py to trash_bin. Step 3: Read hub/tools/compass_decide.py fully. Write hub/tools/cartologist_decide.py with DECISIONS_FILE updated to 'advisors/cartologist/decisions.jsonl' and any 'compass' strings in help text or output replaced with 'cartologist'. Move hub/tools/compass_decide.py to trash_bin. Step 4: In hub/WAI-Hub/advisors/gardener/scripts/wheel-tender.sh: replace all 'compass_report.py' with 'cartologist_report.py', 'compass_decide.py' with 'cartologist_decide.py', 'advisors/compass/' with 'advisors/cartologist/', 'compass/decisions.jsonl' with 'cartologist/decisions.jsonl'. Step 5: In hub/WAI-Hub/advisors/gardener/scripts/run_nightly.py: update any compass_report.py reference to cartologist_report.py in the post-tend chain invocation. Step 6: In hub/tools/triumvirate_route.py: update --decisions default path from 'advisors/compass/decisions.jsonl' to 'advisors/cartologist/decisions.jsonl'; update any 'compass-approved' comments. Step 7: Update hub/WAI-Hub/advisors/cartologist/scan_state.json: set advisor_id='cartologist', advisor_name='Cartologist — Fleet Dashboard & Decision Engine'; update last_report path if it still contains 'compass'; update data_sources entry for lathe (already updated by Spinner lug) — verify spinner path is present. Step 8: In hub/AGENTS.md: replace 'compass_report', 'compass_decide', 'compass/' with cartologist equivalents. Step 9: In hub/WAI-Hub/skills/wai/wai.md: same replacements. Step 10: Run grep -ri 'compass' hub/WAI-Hub hub/tools hub/AGENTS.md to verify zero matches. Fix any remaining occurrences. PART B — FLASK WEB APP: Step 11: Check if flask is installed: python3 -c 'import flask' 2>&1. If ImportError, run pip3 install flask. Step 12: Create hub/tools/cartologist_web.py with 5 routes on port 8080.
